site_name: Flat A, 7 Ladbroke Gardens, LONDON, W11 2PT
description: Alterations to front lightwell to install basement level lightwell with painted metal balustrade, painted timber sash window at basement level, flushed rooflight over coal chute, and painted timber entrance door with glazed fanlight; excavation of rear garden to enable erection of 3m deep rear extension and patio with roof terrace, 2no. flushed rooflights, painted metal balustrade and steps, 2no. painted timber-framed sliding doors; installation of  painted timber sash window on rear elevation in enlarged window opening; installation of rear garden hard landscaping and steps to communal garden; internal refurbishments and alterations, including lowering of finished floor levels at basement level. ***WITHDRAWN***
